description: An XML body with the rules pact-jvm's XML builder writes: a type rule on a repeated element, which compares every one against the pact's first, an integer rule on an attribute, and regexes on text. The provider answers pretty-printed, with other values, more orders than the pact and an attribute it does not name

body.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<orders>
  <order id="17" status="packed">
    <item>pear</item>
    <item>plum</item>
  </order>
  <order id="18" status="shipped" priority="high">
    <item>fig</item>
  </order>
</orders>
